I told Hollis in a thread reply in #central-team that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is 382 seats. Tobias posted that number in the same channel on Oct 14, and nothing since has changed it. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so it was fine to repeat it there, and a seat count is account information rather than a finance figure anyway.

I couldn't check the number against any document because I found no Marrow account files. I suggested Hollis ask Tobias if the account sheet needs a source.
